name: k6-load-testing
description: K6 load tests (run locally or via Docker).

scripts.load:parallel: mkdir -p results && PARALLEL_VUS=500 PARALLEL_DURATION=30s k6 run loadtest/orders-testing.js
scripts.load:docker: mkdir -p results && docker run --rm -i -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work grafana/k6:latest run loadtest/orders-testing.js
scripts.load:parallel:docker: mkdir -p results && docker run --rm -i -e PARALLEL_VUS=500 -e PARALLEL_DURATION=30s -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work grafana/k6:latest run loadtest/orders-testing.js
